verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents one event-driven automation: transformations run automatically after a connection sync completes, or on a set schedule. It also orchestrates pre-built and custom transformations in the destination. This is a fixed sync-then-transform trigger, not a general rule engine where users define their own conditions and actions. Missing for 10: user-defined event→action rules, a range of trigger types beyond sync completion, outbound actions (for example webhooks or notifications) configurable per event, details on what Fivetran Alerts can trigger, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
